# apple_submit_game_center_challenge (Action)

Submits the version being prepared of a Game Center challenge to App Review, by adding it to the platform's review submission that is being prepared, or a new one. The version needs a localization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_submit_game_center_challenge" "example" {
  config {
    app_id  = data.apple_app.example.id
    item_id = apple_game_center_challenge.example.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of an app the Game Center challenge belongs to.
- `item_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center challenge, e.g. `apple_game_center_challenge.example.id`.

### Optional

- `platform` (String) Platform of the review submission: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `TV_OS`, `VISION_OS`. Defaults to `IOS`.
- `submit` (Boolean) Whether to submit the review submission. Set it to `false` to add other items to the same submission. Defaults to `true`.
